Sonor #2 (262 s) under receiver time, Einstein/relativity, signal timing, atmosphere and multipath (N16-N28). Revision C5: enters at 214.25 s on its own quiet swell (source 0-14 s) with NO added fade-in, so it rises underneath Vastness's natural fade. Ends at the N28/N29 gap (465.2-465.5 s) as before (2 s crossfade into cue 03, kept by owner decision); last 9.9 s of the file unused.

Final 125.9 s of Vastness (so the file's natural ending lands at the end of the narration) under accuracy layers, WAAS/new signals, applications and the outro (N29-N36). Longer than the owner's ~102 s draft because the boundary moved to N28/N29.

timing.basis: measured narration track fnt-e2ceed888682 (current values, informational)
timing.notProductionDuration: 590.1 s is NOT a fixed production duration; every timeline value is derived from segment anchors and must be recomputed when the narration/TTS timing changes
timing.recomputeRule: cue 01 starts at 0 and runs to Vastness's natural end (no trim); cue 02 starts 1 s before the centre of the N15/N16 gap with no added fade-in; boundary 02/03 = centre of the N28/N29 gap, crossfade window = boundary +/- crossfadeMs/2; cue 03 ends at the narration track end and its sourceStartMs = vastnessDurationMs - (cue03 end - cue03 start) so the file natural ending lands on the narration end

cue01End.note: Vastness natural end (229.82 s source); not tied to a segment gap

crossfades.anchor: Sonor entry = centre of the N15/N16 gap minus 1 s (as in the baseline); window end = Vastness natural end
crossfades.note: Gradual morph entirely under continuous narration; it is NOT inside a gap and does not claim to be. Bed-envelope simulation (C5): thin seconds (< -6 dB re nominal) 13 -> 1, minimum -12.3 -> -6.4 dB, no dropout.
The 2 s crossfade is centred on the gap but spans about 1750 ms of speech; the gap itself is only 250 ms. The transition happens UNDER narration (ducked), not in silence.

repeatRisk.note: After revision C5 cue 03 replays 100% of cue 01's material (cue 01 now uses the whole file), about 360 s later (was 89%). Owner decision: keep Vastness for cue 03. Mitigating: Vastness is very uniform (LRA 2.1 LU, 1.6 dB range); the audible risk still has to be judged by ear.
options: keep (preserves the natural ending; recommended unless listening shows a recognisable motif)
start cue 03 from the beginning of Vastness (deliberate bookend motif, but no natural ending: needs a fade-out)
use another approved track for cue 03 (needs a new owner decision; the two excluded tracks are high-dynamic)
